summary: Original ideas come to you easily. You think outside the lines without trying, connect things other people keep separate, and solve problems sideways. Insight flows.
body: Original ideas come to you easily. You think outside the lines without trying, connect things other people keep separate, and solve problems sideways. Insight flows. You're a natural at the fresh angle, the unexpected solution, the idea nobody asked for that turns out to be the answer. Because it's easy, the risk is collecting clever ideas and never building any of them. The work is following one through. Land it and the originality becomes more than a party trick.
gift: At your best: inventive, quick, full of fresh angles.
shadow: The trap: collecting clever ideas and never building one.
integration: Let thinking and speech and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Strong for innovation, problem-solving, and tech; weak for routine detail and steady communication.
do: Follow one idea all the way through
Build the clever thing, don't just think it
Use the angle on something real
